fine_lines.title: cuisine vs food
fine_lines.explanation_ar: food كلمة عامة لأي شيء يُؤكل، مطبوخاً أو غير مطبوخ، ومن أي مكان. cuisine تعني «المطبخ» بمعنى فن الطبخ وأسلوبه وثقافته في بلد أو منطقة معيّنة. Chinese food = الأكل الصيني، أما Chinese cuisine = مدرسة الطبخ الصينية كلها وطريقة تفكيرهم في الأكل.

examples.sentence: We need to buy some food for the trip.
Italian cuisine is famous all over the world.

fine_lines.explanation_en: "Food" is a general word for anything you eat, cooked or not, from anywhere. "Cuisine" means the art, style and culture of cooking in a particular country or region. "Chinese food" is the food itself, while "Chinese cuisine" is the whole Chinese way of cooking and thinking about food.

fine_lines.title: stop vs station
fine_lines.explanation_ar: station هي المحطة كمبنى أو مكان فعلي. stop هي النقطة التي تتوقف أو تنزل فيها أنت في رحلتك. لذلك نقول This is my stop وليس This is my station.

examples.sentence: Excuse me, this is my stop.
The train station is very crowded.

fine_lines.explanation_en: A "station" is the actual building or place. A "stop" is the point where you stop or get off on your trip. So we say "This is my stop", not "This is my station".

fine_lines.title: dumplings vs empanadas
fine_lines.explanation_ar: كلاهما عجينة محشوّة. dumplings من المطبخ الآسيوي (الصين واليابان) وغالباً تُسلق أو تُطهى على البخار. empanadas من المطبخ اللاتيني وغالباً تكون مقلية.

examples.sentence: The dumplings were steamed in a bamboo basket.
These empanadas are fried and crispy.

fine_lines.explanation_en: Both are dough with a filling. Dumplings come from Asian cooking (China, Japan) and are usually boiled or steamed. Empanadas come from Latin American cooking and are usually fried.

fine_lines.title: food of dreams vs dream food
fine_lines.explanation_ar: المعنى متقارب، لكن food of dreams أقوى، لأن of تدل على الانتماء، فكأن الطعام ينتمي إلى عالم آخر هو عالم الأحلام. ويمكن أن تقول عن أي شيء رائع: the ... of dreams.

examples.sentence: This chocolate cake is the food of dreams.

fine_lines.explanation_en: The meanings are close, but "food of dreams" is stronger: "of" shows belonging, as if the food belongs to another world, the world of dreams. You can say "the ... of dreams" about anything amazing.

grammar.title: Review: past simple vs present perfect
grammar.explanation_ar: الماضي البسيط مع تاريخ أو وقت محدد انتهى (in 2019، yesterday)، فالمضارع التام «عدوّ التواريخ المحددة». المضارع التام للنتيجة والإنجاز وعدد المرات في فترة لم تنتهِ بعد (so far, this year)، أو لحدث له أثر الآن.
examples: I have written three books so far.
I have lost my key, so I can't open the door.
grammar.explanation_en: Use the past simple with a specific, finished date or time (in 2019, yesterday); the present perfect is the "enemy of specific dates". Use the present perfect for results, achievements, and how many times something happened in a period that hasn't finished (so far, this year), or for an event that has an effect now.

grammar.title: Review: present perfect vs present perfect continuous
grammar.explanation_ar: المضارع التام المستمر يركّز على مدة النشاط والمجهود والحالة الحالية الناتجة عنه (مثل الإرهاق). لا نستخدمه مع أشياء تُنجز واحداً بعد الآخر بعدد (كتبت 3 كتب، شاهدت 4 أفلام)، ولا مع أحداث لحظية مثل lose أو launch. وفي كثير من الأحيان الاختيار لك: النتيجة → التام البسيط، المجهود → التام المستمر.
examples: He has been washing the car for two hours, and he still hasn't finished.
I'm exhausted. I have been working since 8 a.m.
They have been studying all morning.
grammar.explanation_en: The present perfect continuous focuses on how long an activity lasted, the effort, and the situation it causes now (like being exhausted). We don't use it for things completed one by one and counted (I've written 3 books, I've watched 4 movies), or for instant events like "lose" or "launch". Often the choice is yours: result → simple present perfect; effort → present perfect continuous.

questions.question: On the bus, you want to get off. You say:

questions.explanation_en: A stop is the point where you get off; a station is the building.

questions.explanation_en: We focus on the effort that made me tired: present perfect continuous.
